newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian T-bill trade -- 2.13 trln rbls transferred.
newsitem.headline: Russian T-bill trade -- 2.13 trln rbls transferred.

text.p: Government securities dealers had transferred 2.13 trillion roubles to their accounts before the market opened on Friday, the central bank's open-market operations department said.
The sum is an indication of potential demand for GKO discount Treasury bills and OFZ interest-bearing government bonds.

The volume of funds transferred has been slipping in line with falling yields as banks lose interest in the securities. The yields fell sharply from 30 percent in May to about 18 percent now. In May, the average amount of funds transferred was about 3.5 billion roubles.
Only money transferred to trading accounts before the market opens at 11 a.m. (0700 GMT) is available for investing in paper that day.

The total limit for short positions available to dealers licensed to conduct repo operations remains 2.00 trillion roubles. The rate for repos taken out on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday remains 18 percent and for repos taken out on Thursday and Friday remains 21 percent. Repos taken out today will expire on July 15.
Details of the last few days' transfers and the central bank's net intervention in the market a week ago, can be seen on page CBGKOINF.
